title: Hollow condensates emerge from gelation-induced spinodal decomposition.
authors: Li, Cheng; Meng, Lingyu; Tong, Yongxin; Lin, Jie; Qi, Zhi
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过p53与DNA形成凝聚体的实验和三相场模型，揭示外围凝胶化诱导旋节线分解生成空心凝聚体的机制，属于相分离中多组分PPI机制建模，方法为物理模拟，对象与互作机制高度契合。
abstract: Recent studies have identified diverse hollow biomolecular condensates, characterized by biomolecule-depleted interiors surrounded by biomolecule-rich shells. Although several formation mechanisms have been proposed, a general thermodynamic driving force remains elusive. Here, we investigate a well-defined system in which the human transcription factor p53 and nonspecific double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) form biomolecule-rich condensates. Introduction of dsDNA containing p53-binding motifs induces a morphological transition to hollow structures, accompanied by a material state transition from liquid-like to gel-like. In vitro assays indicate that the formation of hollow condensates is driven by p21 DNA-induced localized gelation at the condensate periphery. Guided by these findings, we developed a three-component phase-field model that quantitatively recapitulates the formation of hollow condensates. Simulations show that peripheral gelation leads to gradual depletion of protein and Random DNA from the condensate core, triggering spinodal decomposition and lumen formation inside condensates. Together, these results offer mechanistic insights into multicomponent hollow condensates.
abstract_zh: 近期研究已识别出多种中空生物分子凝聚体，其特征为生物分子耗尽的内部被富含生物分子的壳层所包围。尽管已提出若干形成机制，但普遍的热力学驱动力仍不明确。在此，我们研究了一个定义明确的系统，其中人类转录因子p53与非特异性双链DNA（dsDNA）形成富含生物分子的凝聚体。引入含有p53结合基序的dsDNA诱导形态转变为中空结构，并伴随从液态到凝胶状的材料状态转变。体外实验表明，中空凝聚体的形成由p21 DNA诱导的凝聚体外围局部凝胶化驱动。基于这些发现，我们开发了一个三组分相场模型，该模型定量重现了中空凝聚体的形成过程。模拟显示，外围凝胶化导致蛋白质和随机DNA从凝聚体核心逐渐耗尽，触发旋节线分解及凝聚体内部腔体的形成。综合来看，这些结果为多组分中空凝聚体提供了机制性见解。
